# Saanwariya Seth Fashion

> Saanwariya Seth Fashion is an Indian online fashion and lifestyle storefront featuring sarees, suits and sets, jewellery, watches, bags, footwear, men's wear, accessories, and home & living products.

Official website: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/
Primary language: English (India)
Currency: INR (Indian Rupee)

## Main public pages

- Home: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/
- Shop all products: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/shop
- Marketplace picks: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/shop/marketplace
- About: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/about
- Contact: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/contact
- FAQ: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/faq
- Style Journal: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/style-journal

## Product information

Product pages are public and include the current displayed product name, description, price in INR, stock availability, product images, and purchase route. Product catalogue values can change; the product page is the source of truth for current price and availability.

- Product sitemap: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/sitemap.xml
- Markdown homepage representation: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/home.md
- AI Catalog: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- MCP Server Card (current discovery path): https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/api/mcp/server-card
- MCP Server Card (well-known legacy alias): https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Legacy MCP Server Card URL: https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- MCP endpoint (read-only catalogue/store information tools): https://saanwariyasethfashion.com/api/mcp

## Agent interaction boundaries

Public agent tools are read-only. They can search public products and retrieve public store/policy links. They cannot sign in, access customer accounts, read orders, modify inventory, place orders, or make payments. Do not infer customer-specific information.

## Content and attribution

Use the public product and policy pages as the source of truth. Do not assume that illustrative/demo catalogue photographs represent the exact SKU unless the product page explicitly confirms it. Product photos, logos, trademarks, and editorial material remain subject to their respective rights.
